title: Move `ScriptEditor` gui to `DocumentEditorContainer`
body:
<!--
Please target the `master` branch. We will take care of backporting relevant fixes to older versions.

Before submitting, please read our checklist for contributors:

Use of AI must be disclosed and should include a description of how it was used.
-->

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Followup for #115998
- Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/28607#issuecomment-1493395507 (Like `ScriptEditorWindow`, but its not a window)

This is a structural code change, so ScriptEditor can be an actual singleton again. It splits the class between what is needed for the exposed singleton and what is needed for the GUI.
This addresses my previous concern and makes the shader editor not a ScriptEditor https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115998#pullrequestreview-4744870400.
Since the same code is being used for the shader editor, there should be a more reusable class to handle the gui. This is what the `DocumentEditorContainer` is for. This way ScriptEditor can remain a singleton.

~Since I had to adjust the theme logic, this also
Fixes `base_spacing` EditorSetting not applying immediately to the ScriptEditor, it only changed after a restart or toggling floating.
Fixes the ShaderEditor margins to match the look before #115998, it them a bit larger on accident.~
- Edit: theme logic fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113051

## Additional information

Pretty much everything that was in `ScriptEditor` is now in `DocumentEditorContainer`, to minimize changes in this PR (refactoring it so only what is needed to move would make a lot more to review).
In another PR, more things can be moved out for better re-use with the shader editor or better separation, such as using a single `script_editor_cache.cfg`, most file dialogs can be shared, debugger-only things, callbacks that only need to be triggered once. I may make a separate manager class for these.

I put `search_in_files_requested` and `replace_in_files_requested` in deprecated blocks since they aren't emitted anymore since #115998.
`FindInFiles` and the `SearchDialog` are put in ScriptEditor, since they were being accessed as a single instance.
~Floating is now handled with a signal instead of taking a window wrapper or a dock.~
Also moved `ScriptEditor::_update_modified_scripts_for_external_editor` out of ScriptTextEditor, it doesn't belong there.
